title: Active or passive footprint?
instruction: Did you leave it knowingly, or did it appear without you seeing it?

items.why: You decided to share it, so it's an active footprint.

items.text: A GPS location saved in a photo
items.why: The phone writes it into the photo by itself. You can't see it in the photo.
You wrote it knowingly and others can see it.

items.text: Cookies from a website you visited
items.why: The website saves them in your browser, even if you don't click on anything.

items.text: The history of what you search for
items.why: It saves itself, and it shows what you're interested in.
You shared it yourself. Careful, it also gives away that you're not at home.

items.text: How long you watch which video
items.why: The app quietly measures it and uses it to pick your next videos.

debrief: You can see your active footprint because you create it yourself. The passive one forms quietly: location, cookies, history and time spent on videos. It often gives away more about you than what you share.
